meta.title: HDDS-13114. Make MaxSubCompactions configureable for manual compaction
meta.body_summary: Propose adding configurable max sub compactions for manual compaction in RocksDB via ManagedCompactRangeOptions and a new ozone configuration key, aiming to control CPU usage during compactions.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added configurable max sub compactions; reviewer rejected approach, wanted per-operation compaction options only via ini file; PR iterated but stale closed after 5 months without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 21943 changed lines across 192 files, this is a very large change by absolute volume, largely due to a merge of main bringing many unrelated changes; the core compaction configuration changes are small. The PR was closed without merge, which is not surprising given the scope management issue and unresolved design feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer swamirishi stated that compaction options should not be applied to automatic background compactions; they are only needed for manual compactions. He also insisted that such options should come from an ini file, not individual ozone configuration keys, and referenced HDDS-12484. The author attempted to address this by limiting the options to manual compaction, but the review wasn't updated.
review_details.performance_claim: Make MaxSubCompactions configurable for manual compaction to control CPU usage during compactions, allowing trade-off between compaction time and resource usage.
review_details.rejection_signals: Reviewer requested changes regarding configuration approach; PR remained stale and was auto-closed after months without further review engagement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent implemented feature but did not align with project's configuration management philosophy (ini-based vs per-key); the required follow-up to reconcile with maintainer's expectations exceeded the agent's ability to persist through process hurdles.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewer swamirishi manually reviewed the code, commented inline that compaction options should be limited to manual compactions and sourced from ini files, not individual config keys.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or test evidence in PR body or review; only narrative claim of controlling CPU.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after extended inactivity; no follow-up after author's last commits.

core_change_summary.description: Added ManagedCompactRangeOptions to RDBStore and RDBStoreBuilder, introduced configuration key 'rocksdb.manual.compaction.max.sub.compactions' in RocksDBConfiguration, and adjusted CompactionService to use the configured value for manual compactions. Later commits limited the option to manual compactions only, reverting changes that applied them globally.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changed lines (thousands) come from a merge of upstream/main, inflating the change count; the core manual compaction changes are only tens of lines.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation added ManagedCompactRangeOptions with setMaxSubCompactions across RDBStore.
Reviewer objected: compaction options should be only for manual compactions and sourced from ini file.
Author adapted: limited max sub compaction setting to manual compaction flows (commit 303f1771).
Subsequent commits fixed PMD, FindBugs, and merged upstream main, drastically increasing file count.
PR converted to draft multiple times, final state closed as stale after long inactivity.

review_signals.summary: Reviewer requested compaction options be limited to manual compactions and not be applied to background compactions; config should come from ini file, not ozone config key.
review_signals.action_taken: Author partially addressed by limiting to manual compactions, but did not switch to ini-file-based configuration.

review_signals.summary: Inline comments linked to CompactionService and RDBStore to illustrate where manual compaction is currently used.
review_signals.action_taken: Author followed up with links to RocksDB documentation, but no architecture change to use ini file.

review_signals.summary: Pointed to RocksDB wiki indicating max_subcompactions default 1 means disabled.
Commented with no body; author likely indicating in progress.
Stale warning after 21 days, then auto-close after 7 days.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by peterxcli (OpenAI_Codex agent) with initial compaction option changes.
Quick review by swamirishi with CHANGES_REQUESTED; detailed inline feedback.
Author made several commits to address feedback and limit scope, but remained as draft.
Several draft/undraft cycles and unused change ripples.
No further reviewer engagement; PR auto-closed after ~5 months due to inactivity.
